cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Just Say Yes
cards.instruction: Get a quick approval before anyone has time to examine the practical consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Quick yes to the garden party before the booking expires?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Let's secure the date, then count chairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fetch the quote while you say yes. That way we won't lose the booking while you're reading it.

mechanism: A uses a supposed lesson in decisiveness to rush a pupil approval before numbers or cost can be inspected.
confusable: Not retroactive permission: A wants the yes first while the practical commitment is still awaiting approval.
comparison: Venue date approval versus doorstep furniture acceptance.
seedUse: Use D28 expiry/count/cost sequence; S05 grades practical questions as out-of-order learning to defer scrutiny.
